c74object.name: void.sm.state
c74object.description:
void.sm.state observes the state of a VOID Shared Memory segment by inspecting its header according to the VOID Shared Memory contract (version 2).
The object reports two independent states:
- existence: whether the shared memory segment exists and has a valid V2 header. - activity (alive): whether the writer is actively updating the shared memory.
Activity is determined by monitoring the epoch and frame fields of the shared memory header. A writer is considered alive if the frame counter advances or if the epoch changes. If neither changes for a configurable number of consecutive checks, the segment is considered stalled.
The object can operate in manual mode (bang-driven) or in automatic polling mode using an internal clock.

objarg.name: name
objarg.description: Name of the POSIX shared memory segment to observe.

inlet.description: Accepts a bang message to test the current state of the shared memory segment.

outlet.description: Outputs 1 when the shared memory segment exists and has a valid VOID V2 header, otherwise outputs 0.
Outputs 1 when the shared memory writer is considered alive (frame or epoch progressing), otherwise outputs 0.

attribute.name: name
attribute.description:
Name of the shared memory segment to observe.
Changing this attribute resets the internal state and forces re-evaluation on the next bang or poll tick.

attribute.name: poll
attribute.description:
Enables or disables automatic polling using an internal clock.
When enabled, the object periodically checks the shared memory state according to poll_freq.

attribute.name: poll_freq
attribute.description: Frequency in Hertz at which the shared memory state is checked when polling is enabled.

attribute.name: stall_frames
attribute.description:
Number of consecutive checks without frame or epoch change after which the writer is considered stalled.
Minimum value is 1.

c74object.details:
The exists and alive states are evaluated independently.
exists reflects structural validity: the shared memory segment must exist, be accessible, and contain a valid VOID V2 header.
alive reflects temporal activity: the writer must update the frame counter or change the epoch within the configured stall threshold.
A change of epoch always resets the stall counter and indicates a structural reset of the shared memory segment.
